blocks.html: At Face Skin & Body Bar, we specialize in advanced radiofrequency (RF), RF microneedling, and non-invasive lower facelift alternatives to help you achieve a youthful, rejuvenated appearance without the downtime of surgery. We are the leading clinic in Calgary offering a comprehensive range of devices and treatments designed specifically for non-surgical lower face lifting and skin tightening.

More and more people are choosing non-surgical skin tightening treatments due to their minimal invasiveness, reduced recovery time, and impressive results. If you're searching for "skin tightening treatments near me" or "non-surgical facelift Calgary," Face Skin & Body Bar is your ideal destination. Our experienced providers combine medical-grade skincare with state-of-the-art technology to deliver optimal outcomes. We understand the nuances of RF and RF microneedling and use precise parameters to maximize results and client satisfaction.
We offer a variety of skin tightening treatments to address different needs and concerns:

blocks.text: RF Skin Tightening Treatments with Bipolar RF Wand (Forma)
blocks.html: RF Skin Tightening Treatments with Bipolar RF Wand (Forma)

At our clinic, we specialize in radiofrequency (RF) technology to enhance skin elasticity. Our skilled providers use RF wands to target specific facial areas, delivering precise and effective results.

items: Maintenance/Prevention: To maintain facial volume and enhance skin brightness, we recommend one session per month. This relaxing treatment, often described as a "hot stone massage for the face," instantly contours and brightens the complexion.

Significant Changes:  For reversing signs of aging, we recommend a series of 4 to 6 weekly sessions, followed by monthly or quarterly maintenance treatments. This addresses loose or sagging skin concerns or an undefined jawline.

blocks.html: As the only clinic in Calgary with this specialized device, we can address significant volume loss and sagging in the lower face. Our hands-free cheek and chin radiofrequency applicators deliver consistent heat for up to 45 minutes, stimulating collagen and tightening skin. We recommend 4, 6, or 8 sessions depending on individual needs. The chin applicator also reduces submental fat, ideal for those looking for double chin reduction and more jaw definition. This treatment is a more powerful intervention than the RF wand and is great for clients already experiencing sagging and definition loss in your lower face. It requires a weekly commitment but can produce fantastic results with zero discomfort.

blocks.text: RF Microneedling - Facial Rejuvenation for Contouring & Anti-Aging
blocks.html: RF Microneedling - Facial Rejuvenation for Contouring & Anti-Aging

You can address multiple signs of aging with our targeted RF Microneedling treatments. This powerful combination of radiofrequency and microneedling stimulates collagen production, resulting in lifted, tightened skin, improved contour, and a refined skin texture. Effectively minimize wrinkles, fine lines, drooping brows, and heavy nasolabial folds. For a complete facial transformation, consider a combination of 3-4 RF Microneedling sessions alongside 4-6 of our Non-Invasive Lower Facelift sessions, customized to your specific concerns. This combination of treatments can produce transformational results and true facial rejuvenation.

To maximize the longevity of your skin tightening treatments, we highly recommend incorporating medical-grade skincare into your daily routine. At Face Skin & Body Bar, we are proud to offer AlumierMD products. Quality skincare enhances the results of aesthetic procedures just like a balanced diet enhances physical exercise.

What is RF skin tightening? Radiofrequency skin tightening uses energy waves to heat the skin, stimulating collagen production and tightening the skin.
Is RF microneedling painful? Most clients experience minimal discomfort. We take steps to ensure your comfort during the procedure.
How many treatments are needed? The number of treatments depends on your individual needs and concerns. We'll create a personalized plan during your consultation.

What is the recovery time for non-surgical skin tightening? There is typically little to no downtime with these treatments, for RF Microneedling the downtime can range from 1 to 7 days depending on the procedure.
Do you offer financing options for skin tightening treatments? Yes, we do! Contact us directly to discuss our flexible financing options and partnership with Medicard.
